mentions.name: Inbox Toll
mentions.description: Email tool that makes senders pay a fee before their message actually lands in your inbox, with the toll settable as low as $0.01.
mentions.problem: Real humans still send unwanted email that lands in the inbox (the "real human, still spam" problem).
mentions.source_excerpt: 1. Inbox Toll - solves the "real human, still spam" problem by making the sender pay a fee before the email actually lands in your inbox. Set your toll as low as $0.01.
